source_observations.finding: Parsed main autoclaved goethite Cu203667 mg/kg; S1 nonautoclaved23600 mg/kg and difference-16%. These do not reconcile without correcting a source value. Original main layout required; no numerical correction or accepted observation made.
S3 says n=3 for goethite L9 extraction; S4/S5 captions say n=2. Replication basis unresolved.

Phase legend names magnetite, lautite, zinc titanium oxide, corkite, ammonium hydrogen aluminium phosphate hydrate and adamantyl methanol; no goethite phase label appears in that panel. Source-labelled goethite must not be equated with pure mineral goethite. Feed origin and phase assignment validity remain unchecked.

Selected goethite condition A1B3C3D3, 1% solid,4% energy source,10% inoculum,pH2. Source reported yields100%Mn/Co and96%Y require primary denominator/control checks; not isolated-product or total-feed recovery.
